stem.text: A tennis ball is hit so that it leaves the racket with velocity $v$ at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal.

stem.alt: Diagram of a velocity arrow v at angle θ to a dashed horizontal line, with a vertical arrow labelled v_y.

stem.text: The vertical component of the velocity is $v_\text{y}$.
What is the magnitude of the horizontal component of $v$?
